items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: you went out to Hollywood to do an engagement with Selznick

ctx.x: Okay, so anyway you went into the Onyx Club and you stayed there for about a year. I've got a copy from DownBeat, September '38 and here it says that after remaining at the Onyx Club for almost a year you, that's when you went out to Hollywood to do an engagement with Selznick?
